logstalgia_threads.description: Number of worker threads (0 = auto-detect CPU count)

logstalgia_format.description: Log format type — Apache Combined or Nginx Combined

logstalgia_font_path.description: Path to TrueType font for rendering text

logstalgia_precompiled_favicon.description: Use precomputed favicon cache for faster rendering

logstalgia_width.description: Output width in characters (0 = auto-detect terminal size)

logstalgia_height.description: Output height in lines (0 = auto-detect terminal size)

logstalgia_hostnames.description: Show client hostnames/IPs instead of masked dots

logstalgia_paths.description: Show full request paths instead of masked URLs

logstalgia_progress.description: Show a progress bar during replay

logstalgia_buffered.description: Buffer log input before rendering (recommended for high volume)

logstalgia_buffer_size.description: Lines to buffer before flushing to display

path.description: Path to log file (required); use '-' for stdin

description.description: Optional human-readable name for this log source

logstalgia_log_files.description: List of log files to stream (supports multiple files and stdin)

logstalgia_default_log_path.description: Fallback default log file path (used if log_files is empty)

logstalgia_access_log_path.description: Legacy alias for the access log file (deprecated; prefer log_files)

logstalgia_output_video_path.description: Path to output video file (requires FFmpeg support)

logstalgia_framerate.description: Video frame rate in frames per second

logstalgia_timescale.description: Show a time scale bar at the top of the screen
